# i18n Requirements Checklist: English and Vietnamese Language Support

**Purpose**: Check that the language-support requirements are complete, clear and testable before implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Language selection and persistence

- [ ] CHK001 Is the set of supported languages fixed and stated, with no implied third option? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the default language for a visitor without a choice stated, including what counts as "no choice"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Is every place the switcher must appear named, including mobile layouts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it stated whether switching keeps the visitor on the same page and address? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the lifetime of the remembered choice (reload, later visits, other pages) defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it stated that the choice is per browser and not tied to the account? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the behaviour for an invalid saved value defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Fallback behaviour

- [ ] CHK008 Is the fallback for a missing translation defined, and is showing a raw key explicitly ruled out? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, E3]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it clear which texts change language in this Story and which stay as today until SCRUM-92/93? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it stated that user and seed content is never translated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Error-message coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Does the spec require a message in both languages for every error kind the server can report? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 Is a generic message required for unknown error kinds? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, E4]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the pages whose errors must follow the language listed explicitly, and the rest named as out of scope? [Scope, Spec §FR-009, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the site's own connection and invalid-response errors covered, not only server-sent ones? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]

## Locale-aware formatting

- [ ] CHK015 Is it clear which values must follow the language (dates, times, numbers) and which stay fixed (currency)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Can "follows the chosen language" for dates and numbers be checked objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Accessibility of the switcher

- [ ] CHK017 Is it required that the page declares its current language to assistive technology? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements stated for the switcher's accessible name and for announcing the current language? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 Is keyboard operation of the switcher required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Acceptance criteria quality

- [ ] CHK020 Does every acceptance criterion of SCRUM-91 (AC1–AC5) and every edge case (E1–E4) map to at least one acceptance scenario? [Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the success criteria measurable without knowing the implementation? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Agent note: FR-012 was added after the first draft of this checklist to cover CHK018 and CHK019.
